title: The Truth of Mother
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji pressed the jade slip that had carried twenty years of weight against his brow center, the seal of the Tianji Record shuddered violently—the fifth page, a blank scroll that prophets of all ages had sought but never found, had been hidden within his bloodline all along.

text.content: The wind in the valley turned biting cold. Chen Ji knelt on the碎石 stones with one knee, his left hand gripping Ye Qing's icy wrist while his right still clutched the faintly glowing jade slip. Her breath had grown so faint it was nearly undetectable, only a few broken syllables from her lips proving she still lived. The distant horns grew ever closer—Tianqing Sect's encirclement was tightening rapidly.

dialogue.content: Chen… Chen Tianming… let me… protect her… at that time… you were already…

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. Chen Tianming—the name of the previous Tianji Record holder, his father whom he had never met. Twenty years ago his father passed the Tianji Record to him then vanished, yet now this name connected to his mother. Ye Qing, as the Holy Demon Sect's Saint, was commanded to protect an ordinary woman in those days? The karmic connections were far more intricate than he had known.

dialogue.content: She left the last of her possessions… for you… the jade slip contains… her words… quickly… open it…

text.content: Ye Qing's fingers weakly traced across Chen Ji's palm, then fell limp. He gently laid her upon the ground, his movements tender as if handling a delicate porcelain. Gazing at the jade slip in his palm, his thumb brushed across its smooth surface—only to be met with an overwhelming sense of recognition. It was a resonance from the depths of his bloodline, a warmth he had never experienced yet felt carved into his very soul.

dialogue.content: (Mother, what have you left for me?)

text.content: The moment Chen Ji pressed the jade slip to his brow center, a gentle white radiance burst forth from within, flowing down his brow, temples, and neck before finally gathering where the Tianji Record's mark resided upon his chest. The light was warm yet not blinding, carrying an aura of reassurance, as though someone had embraced him gently in the darkness.

The voice was as light as flower petals scattering in the wind, yet it seared itself clearly into Chen Ji's consciousness. His entire body went rigid, fists clenching involuntarily, nails digging deep into his palms as blood dripped through his fingers unnoticed. After twenty years of waiting, those words reached his ears at this life-or-death moment—yet it was only a soft call.

Mother knows you were called atrash from childhood, enduring contempt and bullying. Mother knows they cursed you as a cursed star, saying you brought death upon your father. Mother knew it all… I'm sorry… Mother failed you…

Chen Ji's eye sockets reddened, yet he forced the tears back. Chen Ji never cried, not even when his fellow disciple broke three of his ribs and threw him into a cesspit. But now, twenty years of suppressed grievance and longing surged wildly against his mental defenses. In the distance, the horns grew more urgent—Ling Yuan's lackeys would arrive at any moment, yet here he stood before his mother's final legacy.

dialogue.content: Mother doesn't ask for forgiveness, only that you remember—you are notrash, never were. Your veins carry the purest bloodline of the Chen family, inheriting the true will of the Tianji Record. Mother saw your destiny the moment you were born… saw that this fragmented Tianji Record would choose you…

text.content: Chen Ji jerked his head up, his pupils reflecting the phantom image formed from his mother's fragmented consciousness—a blurry yet gentle feminine face, overlapping with the portrait hanging in that dilapidated house from his memories. She had known all along? Predicted his bond with the Tianji Record even before his birth? In this moment, a question that had long confused Chen Ji finally found its answer.

dialogue.content: So when you were born, Mother sealed something into your body—the fifth page of the Tianji Record. Ji'er, that page is the 'page of breaking the game' that prophets through the ages searched their entire lives to find. It exists in no scripture, in no forbidden land—it has been dormant within you, waiting to be awakened.

text.content: The fifth page of the Tianji Record. Chen Ji's heart seemed clutched by an invisible hand. According to Mo Xiansheng, the Tianji Record consisted of nine pages, and he currently possessed only four fragmented records—yet the legendary fifth page, capable of overturning heavenly fate and reversing cause and effect, had been hidden within his body all along? If those prophets through the ages who went mad searching for the fifth page, even being manipulated by the Eyes of Heavenly Secrets, could know this, what would they think?

Sharp metallic clashing sounds echoed from outside the valley—the vanguard of pursuers had engaged the outer puppets. Time was running out. Mother's phantom grew increasingly faint; her time was nearly spent.

choices.visible_reward: Obtain qualification to awaken the 'Page of Breaking the局'

text.content: (Mother, I understand. Since this is your choice, I will inherit your will—to shatter that eye, and protect everything I wish to protect.)

Chen Ji slowly closed his eyes, his consciousness sinking inward. He could feel the mark on his chest trembling violently, as if something long dormant was awakening. His mother's consciousness fragments gently enveloped him, like the tender care she had shown when nurturing him in her womb, guiding him step by step toward that long-sealed corner.

choices.description: Refuse to immediately activate the Fifth Page, first take Ye Qing and retreat, preserve the current situation before making plans
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily abandon the opportunity to awaken the Fifth Page
choices.visible_reward: Preserve Ye Qing, retain room for future choices
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan's encirclement is closing in, delay may result in Ye Qing being captured

text.content: (Mother, I'm sorry... I cannot awaken it yet. Those outside won't give us this time, I must get her out first.)

Chen Ji's eyes snapped open, tucking the Jade Slip into his chest. He hoisted the unconscious Ye Qing onto his shoulder. Casting one final glance toward where his mother's phantom had dissipated, teeth gritted, he raced without looking back toward the dense forest beyond the valley. Behind him, the horn calls were already deafeningly close.

Regardless of Chen Ji's choice, his mother's voice gently echoed in his ears, filled with infinite tenderness and reluctance: Ji'er, remember your mother's final words—that eye has always been watching you, ever since you obtained the Tianji Record, it has been waiting for you to step into its prepared chess game. Do not believe any future it shows you, for those futures are precisely what it wants you to see. Shatter that eye, Ji'er... your mother will always believe in you...

The voice gradually faded into the wind, and his mother's consciousness fragments, like a candle burning to its end, fell into silence with the last wisp of light. Chen Ji felt an emptiness in his chest, as if something that had always warmed him was suddenly pulled away. He stopped at the forest's edge, one hand pressed to his chest, feeling something within slowly awakening—a final legacy his mother had sealed within him with her life, now responding to his call.

dialogue.content: (I will, Mother. I will shatter that eye. The ending you never got to see, I will write it myself.)

text.content: Meanwhile, the Tianji Record mark on Chen Ji's chest suddenly burned with heat. He looked down to see that the always-dormant mark was now radiating unprecedented golden light, and within that radiance, a page of a yellowed scroll slowly emerged—the 'Page of Breaking the Game', which every generation of seers had considered a legend, and for which countless had lost their lives. It truly existed within him, waiting silently since the moment of his birth, for this moment of awakening.

choice.prompt: The Page of Breaking the Game has manifested, Chen Ji must decide how to use this power—

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, using his finger as a pen and Heavenly Mandate as ink, slowly writing the first character on the blank scroll—'Break'. In that instant, the heavens and earth changed color, violent winds howled, and spiritual energy from several li around rushed madly into his body, transforming into the ink strokes on that blank scroll.

choices.description: Reseal the Fifth Page, keeping it as an ultimate weapon against the Heavenly Dao's Eye, allowing no enemy to know of this power's existence
choices.visible_cost: Unable to use the Fifth Page's abilities for now
choices.risk_hint: The sealing process will consume a vast amount of energy, affecting subsequent battles.

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze flickered, forcibly suppressing the impulse in his heart. He withdrew his consciousness from within his body, allowing the fifth page to sink back into the depths of his bloodline. Since his mother had said this page was the key to breaking the situation, it should not be revealed easily—this trump card could only be played at the most critical moment.

In the depths of the dense forest, Chen Ji rushed through with the unconscious Ye Qing slung over his shoulder, the sounds of shouting and killing behind them gradually fading. He found a hidden cave, gently laid Ye Qing down, and examined her injuries. The Demonic Path's Mist skill was slowly repairing her meridians, but what truly caused her unconsciousness was not external wounds—it was the price she had paid years ago to fulfill Chen Tianming's entrustment and protect his mother—a backlash seared into the depths of her soul.

Chen Ji retrieved the now-dim jade slip from his chest, gazing at its lustrous surface. This jade slip had carried his mother's final consciousness and concealed all the past between his father and mother. He gently pressed the jade slip against his forehead—once more, no light shone forth. His mother had truly departed. But what she left behind was sufficient to alter the trajectory of this chess game.

dialogue.content: (Father, Mother, I will find Chen Nian. I will shatter that eye. And then, I will personally end all of this.)

text.content: The sky beyond the cave gradually brightened, and the interminable night finally passed. Chen Ji leaned against the cold stone wall, Ye Qing unconscious in his arms, the newly awakened page for breaking the situation burning in his chest, and his mother's final words before her dissipation echoing in his mind. He closed his eyes, the Tianji Record's mark pulsing slowly against his chest, and that blank scroll awaited his choice—would he inscribe fate upon it now, or preserve it as the ultimate weapon against the Eye of Heavenly Way? Chen Ji knew that this decision would determine the final trajectory of his game against that "eye".
